brief.text: Sunderland away is the main event today, teams are out, and Arteta's been talking Declan Rice's workload, quality over quantity, which sounds a lot like a man managing legs for a long season. On the transfer front, keep the pinch of salt handy: the Julian Alvarez talk, the £52m Man United man and the Martinelli noise are all firmly in rumour territory, nothing close to done. Elsewhere Arteta admitted he's happy playing bad cop with Saka, which is less a fallout and more standards being enforced. And the fixture list has done us again, no Boxing Day football for a fourth straight year.
